faqs.question: How do I know this battery fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits ThinkPad Yoga 260, Yoga 370, X380 Yoga and X260 series. Note Yoga 260 uses a 44Wh cell while Yoga 370/X380 Yoga/X260 use a 51Wh cell of the same part-number family — the part number on your old battery is the safest way to confirm. If you're unsure, send us a photo of the sticker under your laptop on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.
